```{r setup}
#| context: setup
#| include: false
library(shiny)
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r load-data}
#| context: setup
#| include: false
# ── Load your real data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ALL_DATA <- readRDS("./Data/spi_results.rds")

# Derive year range and month labels directly from the data
YEARS       <- sort(unique(ALL_DATA$year))
MONTH_NAMES <- c("Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun",
                 "Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec")

# ── SPI classification ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
classify_spi <- function(val) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(val)   ~ "No Data",
    val >  2.0   ~ "Extremely Wet",
    val >  1.5   ~ "Severely Wet",
    val >  1.0   ~ "Moderately Wet",
    val >= -1.0  ~ "Near Normal",
    val >= -1.5  ~ "Moderately Dry",
    val >= -2.0  ~ "Severely Dry",
    TRUE         ~ "Extremely Dry"
  )
}

CLASS_CONFIG <- tibble::tibble(
  label = c("Extremely Wet","Severely Wet","Moderately Wet",
            "Near Normal","Moderately Dry","Severely Dry",
            "Extremely Dry","No Data"),
  color = c("#0033CC","#2196F3","#81D4FA",
            "#D8D8C8","#FFD600","#FF5722",
            "#7B0000","#666666")
)

COLOR_MAP <- setNames(CLASS_CONFIG$color, CLASS_CONFIG$label)
```

```{r ui-controls, echo=FALSE}
div(class = "controls-row",

  # ── Year ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  div(class = "ctrl-block",
    tags$label("Year"),
    selectInput("year", label = NULL,
      choices  = setNames(YEARS, YEARS),
      selected = max(YEARS), width = "110px")
  ),

  # ── Month ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  div(class = "ctrl-block",
    tags$label("Month"),
    selectInput("month", label = NULL,
      choices  = setNames(1:12, MONTH_NAMES),
      selected = 3, width = "110px")
  ),

  # ── SPI index ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  div(class = "ctrl-block",
    tags$label("SPI Index"),
    selectInput("spi_index", label = NULL,
      choices  = c("SPI-3"  = "spi3",
                   "SPI-6"  = "spi6",
                   "SPI-12" = "spi12"),
      selected = "spi3", width = "120px")
  ),

  # ── Stat cards ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  div(class = "stat-card",
    div(class = "stat-lbl", "Mean SPI"),
    div(class = "stat-val", uiOutput("stat_mean_ui", inline = TRUE))
  ),
  div(class = "stat-card",
    div(class = "stat-lbl", "Dry Area  (SPI < −1)"),
    div(class = "stat-val", style = "color:#FF5722",
      textOutput("stat_dry", inline = TRUE))
  ),
  div(class = "stat-card",
    div(class = "stat-lbl", "Wet Area  (SPI > +1)"),
    div(class = "stat-val", style = "color:#2196F3",
      textOutput("stat_wet", inline = TRUE))
  ),
  div(class = "stat-card",
    div(class = "stat-lbl", "Mean Precip (mm)"),
    div(class = "stat-val", style = "color:#81D4FA",
      textOutput("stat_precip", inline = TRUE))
  )
)
```

```{r server, echo=FALSE}
# ── Reactive slice ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
filtered <- reactive({
  idx <- input$spi_index   # "spi3", "spi6", or "spi12"

  ALL_DATA |>
    filter(
      year  == as.integer(input$year),
      month == as.integer(input$month)
    ) |>
    mutate(
      spi_val = .data[[idx]],
      class   = factor(classify_spi(spi_val), levels = CLASS_CONFIG$label)
    )
})

# ── Stat outputs ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
output$stat_mean_ui <- renderUI({
  m   <- mean(filtered()$spi_val, na.rm = TRUE)
  col <- if (m < -0.5) "#FF5722" else if (m > 0.5) "#2196F3" else "#E6EDF3"
  tags$span(style = paste0("color:", col),
            formatC(m, digits = 2, format = "f"))
})

output$stat_dry <- renderText({
  v <- filtered()$spi_val
  paste0(formatC(mean(v < -1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, digits = 1, format = "f"), "%")
})

output$stat_wet <- renderText({
  v <- filtered()$spi_val
  paste0(formatC(mean(v >  1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, digits = 1, format = "f"), "%")
})

output$stat_precip <- renderText({
  formatC(mean(filtered()$monthly_precip, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 1, format = "f")
})

# ── Map ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
output$spi_map <- renderPlotly({
  df        <- filtered()
  idx       <- input$spi_index
  spi_label <- switch(idx, spi3 = "SPI-3", spi6 = "SPI-6", spi12 = "SPI-12")

  present <- levels(droplevels(df$class))
  pal     <- COLOR_MAP[present]

  df <- df |>
    mutate(
      hover_txt = paste0(
        "<b>", class, "</b><br>",
        spi_label, ": <b>", round(spi_val, 2), "</b><br>",
        "Precip: <b>",  round(monthly_precip, 1), " mm</b><br>",
        "Lon: ", x, "°W &nbsp;|&nbsp; Lat: ", y, "°S"
      )
    )

  plot_ly(
    data       = df,
    x          = ~x,
    y          = ~y,
    color      = ~class,
    colors     = pal,
    type       = "scatter",
    mode       = "markers",
    marker     = list(symbol = "square", size = 6, line = list(width = 0)),
    text       = ~hover_txt,
    hoverinfo  = "text",
    showlegend = FALSE
  ) |>
    layout(
      title = list(
        text = paste0(spi_label, " — ",
                      MONTH_NAMES[as.integer(input$month)], " ",
                      input$year),
        font     = list(size = 15, color = "#E6EDF3",
                        family = "Georgia, serif"),
        x        = 0.01,
        xanchor  = "left"
      ),
      paper_bgcolor = "#0D1117",
      plot_bgcolor  = "#1C2128",
      font  = list(color = "#E6EDF3", family = "Georgia, serif"),
      xaxis = list(
        title    = "Longitude (°W)",
        gridcolor = "rgba(255,255,255,0.05)",
        tickfont = list(size = 10, color = "#8B949E"),
        zeroline = FALSE
      ),
      yaxis = list(
        title       = "Latitude (°S)",
        gridcolor   = "rgba(255,255,255,0.05)",
        tickfont    = list(size = 10, color = "#8B949E"),
        zeroline    = FALSE,
        scaleanchor = "x",
        scaleratio  = 1
      ),
      hoverlabel = list(
        bgcolor     = "#161B22",
        bordercolor = "#30363D",
        font        = list(color = "#E6EDF3", size = 12)
      ),
      margin = list(l = 60, r = 20, t = 50, b = 60)
    )
})
```
